entity: Atlantic City Housing Authority, empty public housing units, HUD mid-2025
what_we_add: 339 'regular' vacancies (no approved reason) of 1,473 units, 23.0%; highest of 91 similar-size non-MTW authorities, 5.9x their 3.9% median; almost half at Stanley Holmes Village, 50% occupied
why: CBS and NJ Globe cite a HUD letter: ACHA only 71.4% occupied vs a 96% goal. Same entity, same month, same direction; it's a total-vacancy number vs our unapproved-vacancy count, and 28.6% vs 23% doesn't disagree. Press on emptying part of Stanley Holmes for redevelopment backs the lead's own caveat.
